name: Glottis Ltd
title: Glottis Ltd - 544557 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Glottis is a freight forwarder with FY26 revenue down on softer freight rates and volumes (89,098 TEUs), margins thin at 5.2% PAT, and receivables up about 70% from extended credit days, a weak-quality signal.

triggers.label: Receivables up ~70% on extended credit
triggers.quote: we have given extended credit days, because of that our trade receivables increased
triggers.highlight: we have given extended credit days

triggers.label: FY26 volumes lower on weak trade
triggers.quote: Volume remained lower compared to last year, largely due to slower global trade movements, inventory correction across major markets
triggers.highlight: Volume remained lower compared to last year

triggers.label: Freight rates soft; FY26 revenue down
triggers.quote: Freight rates remain soft and customers across industry planned shipment cautiously

guidance.value: No numeric guidance; management 'very positive' on FY27
guidance.quote: We are very positive in FY26-FY27, and we are taking lot of measures to cover up this revenue
